directive.quote: For each, find what now does that job in trillion-rust or trillion-workshop, use it, and move the tool one to one under tools/.

old_copy.deleted_with: Old Worker retirement; current shared owners take the admitted host and records work.

preserve: Each step is durably claimed at most once before any mail send, including competing wakes.
A priced active offer, matching stop token or sequence completion ends the sequence.
Late wakes send only the newest overdue step; missing email skips a step permanently.
Current offer rows supply price and trial; every mail retains stop link, one-click headers and postal address.
allowed_deltas: Current content, offers, upgrade target, greeting words and postal address arrive from explicit host seams rather than retired Worker imports.
Facts read/write, start, stop and nextDue are asynchronous; writes carry the exact previous value through the current records door.
The send seam binds the established tools/send-messages sender; no scheduler or account-created hook is added.
banned_substitutions: Retired Worker account, control or database JavaScript imports.
A second live implementation of the sending, record or publication engine.
New runtime content persisted as source files.
